answer.text: Second-order adjustment to duration; captures curvature

explanation.text: The Logic: Convexity = d²P/dy². Adds to duration estimate for large yield moves. Positive convexity beneficial. The Trap: Duration is first-order (linear); convexity is second-order. Cross-Exam Context: IV. Manager's Pro-Tip: For yield moves > 100 bps, include convexity — duration alone understates gains, overstates losses.
